contact.basis: AHN ground level at the plaza between the two silos, outside their footprint.

sources.method: Half-metre AHN samples (EPSG:28992) are bilinearly sampled in the north-up local frame. Only original no-data cells, mostly below building footprints, are filled from adjoining valid ground in the derived preview. The complete original source grid is preserved.
